jobs.description: Import the changes made outside Foundation into the audit chain audit.event (root ADR-0569 §6): every autodeploy state file, with one event per pull request a deploy shipped (first-parent commits since the deploy before it, from the host's git mirror), and the journal's root-written foundation-operator-start lines after the last cursor, keeping each command's action, subject and declared arguments only. Rows go through audit.append as foundation_audit_importer, 50 to a transaction with the source's cursor in the last; a row read twice is written once. `changed` when it appended a row, else `unchanged`. A journal cursor the journal no longer holds is recorded as audit.import_gap and fails the run. The GitHub sources wait for the App and are marked waiting_for_credential.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-19, root ADR-0569 §6); sized as the publisher binary with one connection and the importer's rows (about 1,200 on the first run, a few KB each) and one `git log` at a time; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0386): the first run, the declared exception, appends about 500 deploy files, one event per pull request they shipped (1,267 merged PRs since 07-23, about 440 deployed since 10-07) and 183 journal lines, about 1,200 rows in 25 transactions of 50, each a few milliseconds, plus one `git log` per deploy (about 440, each a few milliseconds); later runs append the few rows of the last 15 minutes

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation, not a data producer: a quarter hour without a deploy or an operator start is `unchanged`. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.

jobs.description: Digest the audit record every hour (root ADR-0569 §4, ADR-0584 §2): audit.make_digest keeps the next digest, the rows the current snapshot sees and the last digest's did not (its trigger checks it against the rows); root's audit-witness.sh signs the SHA-256 of every digest not yet witnessed with the witness key and the pinned cosign, which records it in the public Rekor log; audit.witness_digest keeps each bundle after checking it is for that digest's hash. Only the hash leaves the host. A failed upload leaves the digest pending for the next run. Every Monday 00:05 KST it first recomputes every digest from its rows (audit.verify_all) and checks every bundle against Rekor. `changed` when it kept a witness; `unchanged` with nothing to witness. A digest that does not match its rows fails the run.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-19, root ADR-0569 §4); sized as the publisher binary with one connection, then the pinned cosign signing one small file (its peak is that of a Go binary, tens of MB); systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0386): the first digest covers every row so far (about 1,200 after the first import), hashed in SQL in well under a second; one cosign signature and one Rekor upload, a few seconds; the weekly check rehashes every range (100 rows a day, root ADR-0569 §5) and verifies one bundle per hourly digest against Rekor

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation, not a data producer: an hour without a new audit row is `unchanged`. The importer fails when a row has waited two hours for a witnessed digest, which bounds this job's silence.

assets.description: 플랫폼의 모든 변경(더니어 동작·배포·호스트 명령·PR·지도 편집)을 직원 계정을 열쇠로 한 표 하나. 덧붙이기만 하고, 쓰는 문은 audit.append 하나다. 매시 digest 가 줄들을 해시한다(루트 ADR-0569, ADR-0584).

dependencies.description: 가져온 배포·호스트 명령과 더니어 동작이 한 사슬로 화면에 보인다.
매시 새 줄의 digest 를 먼저 audit.digest 에 남기고, 그 해시를 서명해 Rekor 에 올린 뒤, 번들을 audit.digest_witness 에 남긴다.
